name: hira_pose_goo
desc: Same character, same head, face, upper body, size, colors and cream pattern, same three-quarter view facing left. Change only this: from the waist down his body is still a thick column of dripping brown paint goo merging into a wide puddle on the floor, no legs or feet visible. His near hand is raised up beside his face with the fingers spread, squishing thick sticky strands of goo stretching between the fingers, savoring the slimy feel, and he leers with a big toothy grin. Thick paint dripping from the chin and arms. Same outline and pixel art style.
